scientific_integrity: The proof derives exact factors and strict inequalities for the full parameter domain; numerical checks are supplementary. The endpoint-alternating special case is known and is not claimed as novel; only the interior interpolation and its structural consequences are submitted as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification is restricted to a scalar, linear, nonimpulsive, 2-periodically sampled inhibitory equation. Other sampling schedules, couplings, and nonlinearities are outside the proof. No independent review has been performed.
title: Two deadbeat gains and a singular stability frontier in alternating sampled feedback
